text:
The dish is a paper plate, probably about 18-20 cm across (it spans roughly 260 px in the photo). The almonds cover a patch about 180 px by 170 px, which is roughly 13 cm by 12 cm.

I count about 30 almonds. A single almond weighs about 1.2 g, so 30 almonds come to roughly 36 g.

Almonds have about 6.0 kcal per gram, so 36 g gives roughly 215 kcal.

{"kcal": 215, "mass_g": 36}
